title: Convergence of Practical Muon
summary: Muon is emerging as a promising alternative to AdamW for large-scale neural network training, yet theoretical understanding of its practical implementation remains incomplete, as existing analyses often simplify or omit two key components: (i) practical Newton--Schulz iterations with empirically tuned polynomial coefficients $(3.4445,-4.7750,2.0315)$; and (ii) decoupled weight decay for regularization.
